blocks.text: P-pop supergroups BINI and SB19 beamed with gratitude after making history with their nominations at the 69th Grammy Awards. The two P-pop powerhouses earned nominations in the newly introduced Best Asian Pop Music Performance category for BINI’s “Unang Kilig” and SB19’s “Visa,” respectively. They are the first P-pop acts to receive nominations in the prestigious music awards. Jhoanna, the leader of the girl group, exclaimed via her Instagram Stories, “Grabe ka Lord! Salamat sa lahat!” “Thank you Lord,” member Maloi likewise expressed. “Pinaka-unang Batangueña na na-nominate sa Grammy.
